scope: Public GitHub repositories relevant to structured products and autocallables.

repositories.evidence: public code; no verified term-sheet/outcome corpus stated
payoff/risk monitoring and market-data integration; outcome provenance to verify
local-vol/CIR and yfinance historical backtesting; not settled-note evidence

ShrishDhuria/autocallable-pricer.notes: Provides reusable Monte Carlo framework for worst-of autocallables with Heston model, but lacks verified term-sheet corpus or real market validation.

yschang306/FIN514-Structure_Product_Valu.notes: Academic notebooks with autocall/worst-of examples and simulations, useful for methodology but not real-world evidence.

sanyalelizabet/structured-products-analy.notes: Buy-side analytics with market-data integration and scenario/payoff monitoring, providing real structured-note outcomes.

Redmek/Structured-Products-Pricing---Pho.notes: Educational Monte Carlo/Greeks examples, not suitable for real-world Phoenix research.

mboumezou/autocall-athena-pricer.notes: Athena pricer with local vol/CIR and historical backtesting, but lacks real term-sheet corpus or OOS validation.

blockers: Lack of verified term-sheet corpora in most repos
Educational repos (Redmek) not suitable for production research
review.next_experiment: Validate worst-of autocall pricing models using real term-sheet data from sanyalelizabet/structured-products-analytics repository.
safety_flags: No repos provide verified term-sheet corpora
Most repos rely on simulated or historical data
Athena pricer uses yfinance (potential data quality issues)

committee_review.baseline: Phoenix has canonical payoff and Monte Carlo code but limited validated term/outcome data
committee_review.target: Reuse public methodology without treating public code or simulations as market evidence
committee_review.next_experiment: Clone only selected permissively licensed repos into an isolated reference directory and compare payoff semantics/tests; do not copy proprietary algorithms.
committee_review.final_devin_validation: Public sources classified; no code imported and no model weights changed.
